# task-queue-system

> Portable guide for splitting work into numbered task files and dispatching them across many parallel VS Code Copilot agent chats.

task-queue-system is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/task-queue-system/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
